heading: Track Work
author: Racing Correspondent
paragraphs: Echoes Of Time, Eminent Gold and Sicyon caught the eye when the horses were exercised here on Monday morning (Sept. 21).
600m: Masato (Rayan) 39. In fine trim. Blue Picasso (rb) 39.5. Strode out well.

600m: Amazing Stride (rb) 45. Easy. Don Carlos (rb) 45. Moved freely. Echoes Of Time (Shinde) 40. In fine nick. Royal Tribute (Shinde) 43. Strode out well. Acantha (Srinath) 44. Moved freely. Sunlit Path (rb) 43. Shaped well. Black Rainstorm (Faizan) 44. Worked well.

1000m: Transformative (Laxman S) 1-12, 600/41.5. Stretched out well. Mystic Dew (Shinde), Star Comet (Reza) 1-12, 600/42. Former started three lengths behind and finished two lengths ahead. Regal Beauty (R. Pradeep) 1-12, 600/42. Impressed.
1200m: Eminent Gold (Arul) 1-29.5, 1,000/1-11, 600/40. Moved impressively. Renoir (Shinde) 1-30, 1,000/1-15, 600/45. Moved well. Sicyon (Shreyas) 1-22, 1,000/1-8, 600/40. Moved attractively.
